connector.registryDescription: AI routing, memory, guardrails, and governance. Routes across Claude, GPT, Gemini.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.brainstormrouter.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the justinjilg account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
